newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - West Palm Beach, Fla..

text.p: Public Service Tax Refunding Bonds, Series 1997

Sealed bids for the above-captioned bonds will be received by the City of West Palm Beach, Florida (the City'') 200 Second Street, West Palm Beach, Florida 33402 until 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time on such date as communicated through Munifacts news service not less than twenty-four (24) hours prior to the time bids are to be received.

Such bids will be opened in public at said time and place on said day for the purchase of the City of West Palm Beach, Florida Public Service Tax Refunding Bonds, Series 1997 (the Series 1997 Bonds'') to be issued under and pursuant to the City's Bond Resolution, as amended and supplemented (the Resolution''). The Series 1997 Bonds will mature or be subject to optional and/or mandatory redemption as specified in the Official Notice of Bond Sale. The Series 1997 Bonds will be secured by a pledge of the Public Service Taxes. An approving opinion of Bond Counsel will be furnished to the Successful Bidder at the expense of the City.
When available copies of the Preliminary Official

Statement and the Official Notice of Bond Sale and Official Bid Form relating to the Series 1997 Bonds may be obtained from the Co-Financial Advisors to the City, Dunlap & Associates, Inc., 111 N. Orange Ave., Suite 1010, Orlando, Florida 32801 (407-849-0030) or Fidelity Financial Services, L.C. Hollywood, Florida 33020 (954) 925-5699. Each bid must be submitted on an official bid form (not a photocopy thereof) contained in the Official Notice of Bond Sale and Official Bid Form. The Series 1997 Bonds will be delivered on or about two weeks after the sale and award of the Series 1997 Bonds to the Successful Bidder.
City of West Palm Beach, Florida
